rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The speech 'on Accepting his Election as President of The Republic of South Africa, 14 June 1999', National Assembly, Cape Town, says that 'Today, with the election of the President of the Republic', the forming of the second democratic government began after the members were sworn in, that the President of the Constitutional Court presided, and thanks the members for 'entrusting me with the responsibility of President of the Republic'. It names Nelson Mandela among those present as 'the first President of our democratic government'.

locator.section: Heading and venue line; paragraphs beginning 'Today, with the swearing in' and 'Today, with the election of the President'; paragraph beginning 'The President of the Constitutional Court has presided'; closing thanks
